The Fizzcrank Pumping Station is an oil platform located in the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra. The gnomes built it to make fuel for their flying machines at Fizzcrank Airstrip. One day while a crew was siphoning oil off the pump station in the geyser fields, they found a bunch of strange mechanical parts stuck in their pipelines. Since no gnome can turn down a puzzle, they figured out that all those parts belonged together, and they rebuilt them into a robot that looked like a giant gnome. It turned on, called itself Gearmaster Mechazod, and claimed to have been built by the titans. Flame Throwing is a mage talent that increases the range of Fire spells (but for Frostfire Bolt) by 3 yds per rank, up to 6 yds at max rank 2. This talent is useful in most every PvE and PvP build that makes primary use of Fire spells. This talent is especially useful for Fire Blast, which has a fairly short range. Similar mage talents exist for other spells schools - Arctic Reach in the frost tree extends the range of Frost spells, while Magic Attunement in the arcane tree extends the range of Arcane spells.
The Flarecore Wraps are Tailor-made wristguards that provide bonuses to Intellect and fire resistance. The also give a large bonus to mana regeneration.

Flarecore is a level 60 cloth item collection. The pieces of this collection all have high fire resistance and stamina, as well as various combinations of intellect, spirit, MP5, and spell power. These are intended for caster classes who raid fire-damage dungeons such as Molten Core, Onyxia, and Blackwing Lair. The gloves can only be worn by priests, mages, and warlocks, but the rest of the pieces are open to any class.

Flame Wreath is an ability used by Shade of Aran during his encounter in the abandoned tower of Karazhan, and is one of the most common reasons for a raid's wipe during this attack. The spell creates a circle of fire around three characters in the raid. Should anyone outside these circles cross, the entire raid group will be wiped. A common protection against this is for every raid member to remain still until the spell has expired.

Flavors are the versions or editions of World of Warcraft currently in distribution, including Classic and Retail. This community term alludes to "Vanilla" as a synonym for World of Warcraft: Classic, originating from BlizzCon 2017 when J. Allen Brack made an ice cream metaphor to announce the launch of Classic. He repeated this joke the following year to announce the availability of vanilla ice cream in the concession stands.

The Flightless are a group of drakonid and dragonspawn who rebelled against the Valdrakken Accord in Thaldraszus after the dragons and the Dragon Aspects returned to the Dragon Isles. The dissatisfaction of the dragonkin was due to the treatment of dragonkin appearing as dishonorable, feeling that they were pushed aside, reduced to mere servants, and they felt displaced. They joined the Primalists and conglomerated in the Misty Vale, and also made camps near Valdrakken, Scalewatch Caverns and Rebellious Cliffs. They were all instigated by Belaphon.

Flintlocke's Guide to Azeroth was a webcomic posted sporadically on and had been published from December 9, 2004 to April 12, 2007. It was created using mainly the graphics of the MMORPG World of Warcraft (taking place within World of Warcraft's fictional world of Azeroth) with embellishments. The comics themselves are themed mostly around parodies and references of the game itself. It originally started as a PlanetFargo column written by Dave "Fargo" Kosak in the form of a fictitious interview between Fargo and Flintlocke, a self-styled master hunter who took Fargo along for a bear hunt with disastrous results. Familiars are a valuable addition to a mages skills. They allow her to be more aware of her surroundings and to perform minor espionage and other tasks. However, they can also be a danger - if the familiar is killed, the mage is in trouble. Some magi eschew familiars in favor of focusing more on their magic, channeling energy they would be spending on their familiars into other endeavors. The Kirin Tor, in particular, develops numerous other studies that its members can pursue. The mages in World of Warcraft most closely resemble the focused mage.

The inventor of footcarts was once a poor tinker who used her talents at toymaking in the coastal town of Tidus. The most popular of her products she sold in the marketplace were miniature phlogiston-powered steam tanks. When a tauren scoffed at her toys and attempted to stomp them into pieces, he found himself propelled across the marketplace with the wreckage of the tanks conforming to his hooves and continuing to operate. That night, the toymaker realized that her inventions could have a more practical use, so she crafted two simple carts designed to be strapped to the bottom of the feet. Focus Magic is an Arcane Mage talent. It gives a single target at a time 3% increased chance to critically hit with spells only. When the target critically hits with a spell, the buff's caster also gains 3% increased chance to critically hit with spells for 10 seconds.
Flying High Over Skettis is an achievement for reaching status with the Sha'tari Skyguard.
The Fold is a small Horde encampment located near the Talondeep Pass in Stonetalon Mountains. It is the first stop for Horde soldiers entering from Ashenvale.
Fly Over begins the Uldum storyline along with The Twilight Plot, available in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm as soon as players reach level 83.
The Foe Reaper is a two-handed mace with bonuses to strength and haste. The level 85 version has bonuses to stamina and expertise as well.

Flynn Dunwald is one of the first members of the Dunwalds of the Wildhammer clan that players meet. He and Keely Dunwald have retreated from the Twilight's Hammer clan that razed their town, hiding out in the basement of the Dunwald Holdout in the Twilight Highlands. He later joins his brothers at the Dunwald Town Square in fighting Darunga, the leader of the Twilight that killed so many of their brethren.
Food Coma is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Focus Chi is an ability used by Pandaren Monk during a Pet Battle.
Focused Beams is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Fono is a draenei mining trainer and vendor located on Aldor Rise in Shattrath City. A forge is in the room with him.
Flux is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Follower Trait Retraining Guide is available from Sergeant Crowler at Lunarfall and Sergeant Grimjaw at Frostwall for . It also has a chance of being looted from Follower Retraining Scroll Case (rewarded from the garrison mission Lessons of the Blade). It was briefly rewarded from Relic Hunter: Grimoire of Nameless Void and Wanted: Amethon.
This scroll case will typically contain a Follower Trait Retraining Guide, Follower Ability Retraining Manual or a Follower Retraining Certificate.
Flying Hourglass is a quest reward from Visitor in Shal'Aran.
Foebreaker Vanguard are fel lords located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.

The Fogsail Freebooters are a pirate group found in Kul Tiras. They allow the Horde to use their base of Plunder Harbor as a foothold on the island, after the Horde helped Owings pull a mutiny on the previous captain Rhenik for wanting to sell the crew out to the Ashvane Trading Company.

The Font of Power is found at the start of every mythic dungeon in the dungeon roatation of the current Mythic+ season. It is used to insert a Mythic Keystone to start a Mythic+ dungeon at the keystone's level.
Fly Swarms are flies located in the Writhing Mire in the Spires of Arak.
The Flux Energized Servos drop from the Insurgent Crawler on Mechagon Island.

World of Warcraft: Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth is an anthology of 12 Warcraft short stories by various authors. The stories mainly consist of in-universe tales and legends grounded in the various cultures of Azeroth. The World of Warcraft team and the authors researched established legends within the Warcraft mythos—including elements that they thought deserved more attention—alongside "harebrained ideas" that worked out better than expected as well as inspiration from real-world myths and fairy tale tropes. As stated in the book's introduction by one of its editors, Allison Irons, the authors were free to explore Azeroth through their own vision using direction from the Warcraft team. As
Fogged Crystal is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fool's Wager is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Font of Ephemeral Power is sold by Vilo in Zereth Mortis for .
Flytrap's Life-Dividing Broadaxe is an appearance unlocked by Arsenal: Stitchmasters' Weapons.
Flying disc mounts were added to World of Warcraft with Mists of Pandaria.
Foehn Breezeskimmer is a black drakonid flight master located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
Focusing Iris is a Devastation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Arcane Vigor.
__NOTOC__ Flying Fish Bones is an Iskaaran Fishing Gear Material item. It can be found at on the ground between tables with meat full of chopped sea monster and a pool in Iskaara in the Azure Span.
Followers of Malune are draenei located near Seer Malune on Duskfall Island in Talador.
Flying with Our Colors becomes available after reaching Renown 23 with the Valdrakken Accord.

Forest's Edge is a peninsula-like swath of forest southwest of Stormwind City in Elwynn Forest, located between Mirror Lake Orchard, the Nazferiti river and the small northern river near Westfall. It is the location of a group of gnolls led by an elite named Hogger. A couple of boars also wander around the area. It also contains some herb spawn points, as well as a copper vein or two along the rivers. Westbrook Garrison is found on its northern area. Hogger now resides on his own hill in the southern section.
Foreman Oslow is a human quest giver located near the bridge in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
Foreman Rigger is a rare mob human found by the west end of the Blackwolf River in Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. He had a 4-6 hour respawn timer.
The Force of Magma is a Level 47 quality Two-Handed Mace that improves Strength. It has a chance on hit to blast it's target for extra fire damage.
Foreman's Head Protector is a Level 51 quality Plate Helmet that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.
Forest Leather Belt is a continent drop from level 17 - 25 Eastern Kingdoms mobs.
Forest Leather Chestpiece is a world drop. It has a very low chance to be looted from level 22 - 28 mobs on the Eastern Kingdoms continent.
Forceful Talasite is crafted with Outland Jewelcrafting (50); taught by Design: Forceful Talasite, a Shattered Sun Offensive reputation reward.

Foreman Wick was originally found in the Canals of Stormwind City watching over the construction of the road that leads into Stormwind Harbor. He doesn't know what Baros Alexston was thinking when he hired Mason Goldgild, and believes she brought enough powder to level the entire quarter. The construction crew includes: * Construction Workers * Dwarven Construction Workers * Underwater Construction Workers

Foreman Colbey is stationed at Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord. He is responsible for getting raw ore out of the nearby Wildervar Mine to supply new weapons for the Valiance Expedition, but the yeti Shatterhorn is inside hindering progress. Colbey turns to adventurers for help after his irritated demands to the nearby Wildervar Sentries are ignored.
Footwraps of Teleportation drop from Xevozz in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.
Force Commander Valen is the leader of the Northwatch Expedition Base Camp and a quest giver in Stonetalon Mountains.

These black drakes are seen flying around Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragon Soul raid and the Hour of Twilight dungeon battling the forces of the Wyrmrest Accord. They cannot be attacked, and will never attack players.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Pernic is a worgen mining trainer located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

The Forbidden Jungle comprises the western third of the mainland of Krasarang Wilds. It is bordered by the Sentinel Basecamp, the Ruins of Korja and the Field of Korja. The Forbidden Jungle is infested with spiders, mantid, and even spirits of bears. A Lost Mushan also roams the jungle. The Shattered Convoy can be found on the path between Dustback Gorge in the Valley of the Four Winds and the Ruins of Korja on the way to the Temple of the Red Crane.
Foreman Jinx is a goblin quest giver located at The Skunkworks in Ashenvale. He is tasked with developing a bomb for use by the Horde forces in Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Forest Moths are critters found in Ashenvale, Darnassus, Desolace, Moonglade, Mount Hyjal, and Teldrassil.

For the Ward! is a quest achievement earned for using the fixed-device perimeter wards surrounding the Dawnseeker Promontory or Violet Rise (once they have been phased in) to kill a weakened enemy. Find a nearby troll or mogu and weaken it to where it has less than 10% health. The Zandalari Beastcallers flying overhead work well for this. Drag the target mob near to a perimeter ward and it will activate automatically. Try to make sure no friendly guards are nearby, as the ward itself must land the killing blow. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.

For the Swarm is an expansion feature achievement. Commander Tel'vrak spawns Zan'thik Swamers during the final encounter. Avoid using the Airstrike spell and any AoE spells or abilities so the Swarmers remain alive while focusing down Commander Tel'vrak.
For Adventure! is an ability used by pets during a Pet Battle.
Forceful Adaptable Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.
Forceful Efficient Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.
Forceful Refined Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.
The Foreman's Stability Belt drops from Foreman Scripps in Highland Pass in Stormsong Valley.
Forcewing is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Forbidden Obsidian Claw drops from Maut in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Footpads of Terrible Delusions drop from elite mobs in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

"For Lies And Liberty" is a short story by E.C. Meyers published in the anthology Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth. It is illustrated by Zoltan Boros. The story tells of some freshly risen or newly liberated undead being inducted into Forsaken society in Undercity. __NOTOC__
Forces of the Horned Nightmare is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Horned Nightmare.
Forbidden Reach Glyph Hunter is awarded to players who fly through all eight Dragon Glyphs in the max-level Forbidden Reach.
The Forbidden Reach storyline of the Dragonflight campaign begins in patch 10.0.7.
Forbidden Memoire are found throughout the caves of Dragonskull Island in the Forbidden Reach. Interacting with them, will activate a number of projections.

Forgotten One appeared in The Forgotten Ones mission of Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne, where it was defeated by Arthas Menethil and Anub'arak as they journeyed through the Inner Kingdom of Azjol-Nerub. The quest to destroy it described it as "an unfathomable horror of a long forgotten time".

.]] The Forgotten Coast is the coast that makes up the entire border of western Feralas with the Veiled Sea. Here several water elementals and sea giants roam the shore. Zorbin Fandazzle can be found at the fork in the main road that leads to the coast, through the new Feathermoon Stronghold. There is another path further north that is safer for the Horde to enter the coast with. There is also a murloc fishing village. Sometimes, birds used to swoop in and carry off tadpoles, or it would be attacked by humans or gnolls. Forest trolls are a green-skinned subgroup of trolls found in the forests of Lordaeron. The forest trolls as a whole are also referred to as Amani, after the ancient empire of the same name, but that name can also refer to the Amani tribe in particular. Long before the rise and fall of the kingdoms of men, the Amani trolls of Lordaeron had built an enormous troll empire. After centuries of war and hate, an alliance of high elves and humans finally dealt a crushing blow to the Amani when they defeated a great troll army at the foot of the Alterac Mountains. Forgewright's Tomb is located inside the central rock of Blackrock Mountain. It is the tomb of Franclorn Forgewright.

Forge Camp: Rage is the middle of three Burning Legion Forge Camps in Hellfire Peninsula. This forge camp directly overlooks the Horde outpost of Thrallmar; both the Alliance and the Horde have quests to destroy the fel cannons pointed at the Horde outpost.

Forge Base: Gehenna is one of the two Forge Bases in Netherstorm, situated just west of Eco-Dome Sutheron. It is full of wandering Burning Legion wrathguards, shivarra and mo'arg. It serves primarily as a staging ground for Burning Legion attacks against the Stormspire as it contains a number of teleportation devices.
